jobs.actual_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Asset: ONE independent waist-up portrait for a 2D Chinese cultivation RPG. Opaque muted grey-green background. Target 512x640, preserve source aspect ratio; native dimensions will be measured.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and individual identity, face, build, costume, pose and prop anchor. Input image 2 is ONLY the approved C drawing-style reference, never copy its man, beard, abacus or costume.
Preserve the individual in image 1: sex, apparent age, facial structure, body build, hairstyle, expression, view and props. Redraw with economical clear thin dark outlines, small simple manga facial features, solid grouped hair, broad muted flat colours, a few large clothing folds and ONE restrained structural shadow tone. Preserve simplified identifying robe motifs. No realistic facial modelling, glossy anime skin, individual hair strands, granular texture, intricate embroidery, airbrush, border, lettering, watermark or scenery. No extra objects or gestures. Keep entire head, highest hair, tied bun, hairpins and important props inside frame with visible plain background margin above the highest point, about six percent of height. Preserve source waist-up framing and natural arm/hand visibility; do not invent hands absent from crop. Keep middle-aged people visibly mature. One portrait, no contact sheet.
Identity details: Middle-aged broad-built merchant with warm tan skin, thick straight eyebrows, short moustache and short pointed goatee, dark brown hair streaked subtly grey at temples in a compact high bun tied with olive ribbons. Reserved serious face in three-quarter view looking viewer right. Dark forest-green robe with dark brown edging, muted plum-brown inner robe and ivory crossed collar, brown waist sash with small tan purse and jade ring pendant. One visible hand grips a CLOSED cream folding fan with dark ribs across lower chest angled toward upper viewer right. Preserve closed fan, hand pose, beard length and build.

Asset: ONE independent waist-up portrait for a 2D Chinese cultivation RPG. Opaque muted grey-green background. Target 512x640, preserve source aspect ratio; native dimensions will be measured.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and individual identity, face, build, costume, pose and prop anchor. Input image 2 is ONLY the approved C drawing-style reference, never copy its man, beard, abacus or costume.
Preserve the individual in image 1: sex, apparent age, facial structure, body build, hairstyle, expression, view and props. Redraw with economical clear thin dark outlines, small simple manga facial features, solid grouped hair, broad muted flat colours, a few large clothing folds and ONE restrained structural shadow tone. Preserve simplified identifying robe motifs. No realistic facial modelling, glossy anime skin, individual hair strands, granular texture, intricate embroidery, airbrush, border, lettering, watermark or scenery. No extra objects or gestures. Keep entire head, highest hair, tied bun, hairpins and important props inside frame with visible plain background margin above the highest point, about six percent of height. Preserve source waist-up framing and natural arm/hand visibility; do not invent hands absent from crop. Keep middle-aged people visibly mature. One portrait, no contact sheet.
Identity details: Broad-shouldered sturdy middle-aged man with square weathered tan face, thick eyebrows, clean-shaven mouth and chin, serious frowning lips and eyes glancing strongly viewer right. Dark brown long hair worn half down over shoulders, compact upper bun tied tan cloth and greying temples. Patched dark brown outer coat over muted grey-brown robe and deep green crossing inner lapel, pale collar. Yellow-brown sash and double-lobed ochre gourd at viewer-right waist. Single visible hand at viewer left grips rough wooden walking staff upright. Preserve square build, long half-down hair, no beard, staff and patches.
